- heading "Senior Test Lead" [level=2]
- heading "Ford Motor Company" [level=2]
- heading "Madrid, Spain" [level=2]
- heading "Job Description" [level=3]
- paragraph: In this hands-on, influential role, you will design scalable automation across the full testing pyramid and help engineering teams use AI-assisted tooling where it delivers genuine value.
- heading "The role" [level=4]
- paragraph: You will architect and evolve enterprise-level test automation across unit, contract, integration, API, UI and selective end-to-end testing. Working primarily with Java, TypeScript, Selenium and Playwright, you will embed fast, reliable quality signals throughout the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipeline.
- heading "Responsibilities" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: "Build and evolve frameworks: Design maintainable, reusable and scalable test automation frameworks in Java and TypeScript."
  - listitem: "Strengthen the testing pyramid: Promote strong unit-test discipline and create contract, service-level integration, API and high-value end-to-end coverage."
  - listitem: "Improve UI and E2E quality: Build low-flake Selenium and Playwright suites, including visual regression and practical self-healing approaches."
  - listitem: "Integrate quality into delivery: Embed automated testing into CI/CD so teams receive useful quality signals in minutes, not days."
  - listitem: "Manage test data responsibly: Support data provisioning, masking, refresh and synthetic-data strategies in line with GDPR."
  - listitem: "Optimise and troubleshoot: Improve test speed and reliability, investigate failures and resolve automation issues quickly."
  - listitem: "Turn results into insight: Create reporting that highlights trends, risks and release readiness, not only pass/fail counts."
  - listitem: "Evaluate new tooling: Assess AI-assisted testing and development tools honestly, adopt what works at scale and explain their value and limitations to stakeholders."
- heading "Qualifications" [level=3]
- list:
  - listitem: Strong experience of software-testing experience, including at least 5 years of hands-on test automation.
  - listitem: Strong Java skills, including collections, streams, REST clients and Maven or Gradle.
  - listitem: Strong TypeScript/JavaScript skills, including ES6+ and Node-based test tooling.
  - listitem: Hands-on experience with Selenium, Playwright and Rest Assured, plus testing web services, web UI and REST APIs.
  - listitem: Proven experience designing enterprise-level automation frameworks, ideally in a regulated environment.
  - listitem: Practical experience across integration/contract and E2E testing, with a clear understanding of how these layers relate to unit coverage.
  - listitem: Experience with SQL, synthetic test-data generation, Git workflows and CI tooling.
  - listitem: Strong testing fundamentals, including equivalence partitioning, boundary analysis, negative testing and risk-based prioritisation.
  - listitem: Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication and collaboration skills.
  - listitem: Practical exposure to AI-assisted testing or development tools such as Copilot, Cursor or LLM-based test generation.
  - listitem: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- heading "Nice to have" [level=4]
- list:
  - listitem: Financial services, automotive finance or another regulated industry.
  - listitem: Contract testing with Pact and service virtualisation.
  - listitem: Google Cloud and Cloud Build.
  - listitem: Performance testing with k6 or JMeter.
  - listitem: Security and compliance tooling such as OWASP ZAP, FOSSA or Cycode.
  - listitem: Knowledge of GDPR and security requirements for test data.
